name: safe-migrations
description: Stops Claude from writing database migrations that lock tables, lose data, or cannot be rolled back. A PreToolUse hook checks every migration file before it is written and asks you to confirm risky operations; a reviewer agent explains the safe multi-step alternative.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: prompt you when a migration is risky. deny: block the write and have Claude rewrite it. off: disable the check.
